Every gun is good for it, there are always points where it doesn't go far enough to handle intense combat and, therein, none of the guns are actually good enough. The enemies do some weird law-breaking things with abnormal superpowers, there are blows that can kill in one hit even with the health and shields both at full, but the mobility and reliable shooting of the main character is swell. I played the game on the 4th/5 difficulty level.

The diaries are hilarious. I choked on my own coffee reading them.

No nudity is in the game, nor sex scenes, but as you get hit into a lower level of health it starts tearing off the protagonist's clothes until you're running around in boots and underwear. I think she looks Korean.
its bs. i searching and searching key and nothing. im killing people and zombies with blowup way but after 5-6 mins they are just respawn. dont spend time in this game. just bs.

Can devs please change that stupid hen*ai looking face of her as the main artwork?

Review: 6/10
1. The game is a bare minimum and I really do mean bare minimum TPS. Enemy AI is broken, they aso don't have any hit reaction and are just bullet sponges. They'll simply run at you like a robot until you have poured a certain amount of bullets onto them. And then they just fall own. 
2. The girl, apart from being a gorgeously sexy doll, doesn't have any animations for interaction and combat. You simply just stand and press a button, boom! You have found a diary or won the game. I don't really care at this point.
3. The graphics is where the game shines. It looks photo-realistic in some maps. Tbh, if the devs made an empty map where you just walk around with this sexy girl and do some investigation or something, that'd be great too.

Verdict: Get it on sale. A curvy beautiful girl shooting "badguys" in randomly generated incredibly rendered maps for 4$? Sign up!
crap for something you should paid for, it's good if it was free, the game looks not finished yet, too many things needs to be fix or upgrade

Pretty girl, sexy outfits, and challenging gameplay.

No nudity (unless the mod from the workshop is applied), and no sexuality, which I myself consider a big plus.

One thing that makes this game stand out, imo, is that the game fields change; each time we visit the very same area, its lay-out is different, so we can't just play it out on automatic pilot, so to speak.

游戏有些问题：

1.人物既不能捏脸捏身材，也没有时装可以收集。武器也不能收集，升级什么的。感觉玩了半天玩了个寂寞，没任何成就感。

2.剧情模式要怎么赢（目标）也不好好标明一下，我敌人全清了也不知道接下来该做什么，往哪里走。

3.守护模式可以就躲一个楼的小屋里，敌人会不断往里冲，然后不是自己把自己和队友爆死，就是轻松被爆头。每级都可以这样，感觉就无限这么玩下去没意思，而且什么也得不到。还是我说的，没有东西可以收集，感觉就是在浪费时间。

4. 敌人很多地方能射穿墙很离谱。躲墙后面都没用。而且每个都像是你在跟aimbot对打，永远都知道你位置。

5. 拜托在基地里时候人物视角别跟着镜头转来转去。
